lines: n1
[intense, cinematic, intriguing] What if ChatGPT was INSTALLED... [short pause] in your BRAIN?
n2
[serious, grounded] This isn't pure sci-fi. [short pause] [impressed] DOZENS of people already have chips in their brains, [short pause] controlling computers just by THINKING.
n3
[excited, building fast] So imagine it. [short pause] Every LANGUAGE? [short pause] You speak it. [short pause] Every EXAM? [short pause] Every FACT? [short pause] [triumphant] INSTANTLY.
n4
[huge, epic, triumphant] You'd be the SMARTEST person in HISTORY.
n5
[sudden drop, low, ominous] Until... the twist.
n6
[mysterious, revealing] Scientists measured the speed of human thought: [short pause] about TEN bits per second. [pause] [amused] Slower than an old DIAL-UP modem.
n7
[explaining, thoughtful] So the AI could know EVERYTHING, [short pause] but you'd still think it [short pause] ONE thought at a time.
n8
[epic, rising] Now give it to EVERYONE.
n9
[energetic] Every test? [short pause] EVERYONE scores a hundred. [pause] [serious] Knowing things stops being SPECIAL.
[slower, eerie] And if everyone asks the SAME AI, [short pause] we might all start thinking [short pause] the SAME thoughts.
[slow, intimate, leaning in] So what would still make YOU special?
[warm, powerful] Not the answers. [pause] The QUESTIONS you ask.
[friendly, playful, inviting] So... would you install it? [short pause] YES or NO? [short pause] Tell me in the comments!
